category_pilot.base_contract: spec-team-v1 accepted in SPEC-001 #10 / PR #140; category mapping/family review remains
limitations: separate approved evaluation input/reference before real inference
New frozen dataset, not a bitwise rerun of the historical 3037-card EVAL-006 set. Historical reports are untouched.
Catalog agreement is not independent human quality. Supported matcher awaits human audit; unknown/conflict pairs are excluded from judged precision.
Rules and models share input/reference/evaluator/schema; effective policies differ by actual method and are identified by hashes.
LLM acquisition used two bounded batches: 100 requests then 23, using an immutable verified cache copy. Cache-only warm calls add no gateway charges.
LLM completion cold latency includes 100 seeded cache hits and 23 new calls; it is not an all-fresh 200-card cold measurement. Both phase resources are disclosed.
Local brand cold first model call includes lazy load; peak RSS is process high-water mark. OS page cache was not reset.
Observed GLiNER tokenizer warnings were recorded; weights/tokenizer/settings were not modified after freezing.
No traffic weights: the available clicks file fingerprint differs from the historical approved source. No synthetic clicks or weights substituted.
New-category labels are train-only drafts; there is no claim of real CLI/API category quality before contract/family/source acceptance.
